text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kawasaki Kinen. Hokko 
Tarumae was full of determination to stack 
up results here and earn her challenge 
against Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae felt far more fulfilled here 
than at the Champions Cup. She was 
determined to deliver results. With 
unwavering resolve, she stepped forward to 
face the battle!
